classes.name: StlAPI
classes.summary: Offers the API for STL data manipulation.

staticMethods.name: Write
staticMethods.signature: (theShape: TopoDS_Shape, theFile: string, theAsciiMode?: boolean): boolean
staticMethods.comment: Convert and write shape to STL format. File is written in binary if aAsciiMode is False otherwise it is written in Ascii (by default).

staticMethods.name: Read

classes.name: StlAPI_Reader
classes.summary: Reading from stereolithography format. Reads STL file and creates a shape composed of triangular faces, one per facet. IMPORTANT: This approach is very inefficient, especially for large files. IMPORTANT: Consider reading STL file to {@link Poly_Triangulation | `Poly_Triangulation`} object instead (see class {@link RWStl | `RWStl`}).

instanceMethods.name: Read

classes.name: StlAPI_Writer
classes.summary: This class creates and writes STL files from Open CASCADE shapes. An STL file can be written to an existing STL file or to a new one.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a writer object with default parameters: ASCIIMode.

instanceMethods.name: ASCIIMode
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the address to the flag defining the mode for writing the file. This address may be used to either read or change the flag. If the mode returns True (default value) the generated file is an ASCII file. If the mode returns False, the generated file is a binary file.

instanceMethods.name: Write
instanceMethods.signature: (theShape: TopoDS_Shape, theFileName: string, theProgress: Message_ProgressRange): boolean
instanceMethods.comment:
Converts a given shape to STL format and writes it to file with a given filename.
@returns the error state.
